content: Text-diff table stakes: two paste boxes, live compare, red/green add/delete, line-level highlight, ignore whitespace. Side-by-side is expected; unified/git patch is a plus. jsdiff supplies diffLines/diffWords/diffChars/diffTrimmedLines/createPatch. Diffchecker extras (PDF/Excel/AI merge, server processing, paywalled unified view) are anti-features for a browser-local catalog.
